# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 15 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 15:3 — put out his hand vs. reach out

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "put out his hand and take" | Literal mittat manum suam |
| LOGOS | "reach out and take" | Natural English equivalent |
| PNEUMA | "take from the tree of life" | Omits the hand gesture |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** LOGOS 'reach out and take' is natural and preserves the motion. EMET's 'put out his hand' is more literal. PNEUMA loses the gesture. Adopted LOGOS.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.
